steps: GET the discovery document from target.discoveryPath
decode it as EventServerCapabilities
validate protocol, transports, features, endpoints, and limits
expect: protocol is putnami.events.v1
every listed transport has a matching endpoint entry
payload support includes json

steps: POST a publish frame to endpoints.publish.path using a generated conformance topic
include a JSON payload, key, dedupeKey, attributes, and traceId
decode the response as a publish acknowledgement
expect: response protocol is putnami.events.v1
response includes id, topic, and timestamp
topic matches the published topic

steps: POST a publish frame missing topic or payload
decode the error response as EventServerError
expect: request is rejected
error code is invalid_frame or invalid_envelope
error protocol is putnami.events.v1

steps: open endpoints.sse.path with topic and from=latest
publish an event to the same topic through HTTP publish
read one SSE event frame
expect: SSE id matches the frame id
frame type is event
frame payload matches the published payload

steps: publish an event and record the accepted id
connect to SSE with Last-Event-ID or from set to the recorded id
read the replayed event or the next event according to the advertised cursor mode
expect: server honors Last-Event-ID when from is omitted
server rejects unsupported cursor values with invalid_cursor
replay behavior matches features.cursor

steps: open endpoints.websocket.path
send an auth frame when the target requires credentials
send a subscribe frame for a generated conformance topic
publish an event to the same topic through HTTP publish
expect: server emits an ack or event frame after subscription
received event frame uses canonical EventServerFrame fields
payload matches the published payload

steps: open endpoints.websocket.path
send a frame with a wrong protocol identifier
expect: server emits an error frame or closes with a protocol error
error code is protocol_mismatch or invalid_frame

steps: call putnami.events.v1.EventServer.Capabilities
decode the response with proto/putnami/events/v1/event_server.proto
expect: response matches the HTTP discovery capabilities
protocol is putnami.events.v1

steps: open Subscribe for a generated conformance topic
call Publish with a JSON payload for the same topic
read one EventServerFrame from the Subscribe stream
expect: Publish returns id, topic, and timestamp
Subscribe emits an event frame with the published payload
all messages use the canonical proto service

steps: call putnami.events.v1.EventServer.Health
expect: response protocol is putnami.events.v1
status is ok, degraded, or unavailable

steps: read limits.maxPayloadBytes from capabilities
when the limit is greater than zero, publish a payload larger than the limit
expect: server rejects the request
error code is payload_too_large

steps: configure a delivery:push subscription so the provider POSTs to the receiver route
POST a provider push wrapper carrying a base64-encoded canonical Envelope to the receiver
include a valid audience-pinned OIDC bearer token minted as the events-server service account
expect: receiver verifies the OIDC token (issuer, audience, and service-account-email allowlist) before dispatch
the handler runs once and the receiver responds 2xx to acknowledge
the decoded envelope matches the published envelope

steps: POST a provider push wrapper with a missing, expired, wrong-audience, or non-allowlisted service-account token
expect: receiver rejects the request fail-closed without dispatching the handler
response status is 401 or 403

steps: deliver one message the handler acknowledges, one it permanently rejects, and one whose handler fails transiently
expect: acknowledged delivery responds 2xx (ack)
permanently rejected delivery responds 4xx (dead-letter)
transiently failed delivery responds 5xx (provider retries)
